sources.evidence_limit: Python output, wildcard template substitution, statuses, atomic root lock entry and bounded persistence are explicit offline choices; native forms and timing are not established

source_translation.service: Explicit opt-in SourceTranslations plus ordinary FILE backend; force .KL lookup and accept captured includes/shapes only
source_translation.products: Sibling .py and optional .LS, source unchanged, explicit overwrite permission and bounded byte/history budgets
source_translation.publication: Full product preflight, listing first and Python last; each rooted host replacement atomic, listing-only partial failure is recorded
source_translation.persistence: Configuration and bounded source/product hashes/history only; no loading, attachment, execution, native PC output or compiler requirement for runtime-only import

wildcard_files.selection: Nonrecursive final-basename star COPY/DELETE over explicit MemoryFiles, DirectoryFiles or DeviceFiles; case-insensitive matching and deterministic order
wildcard_files.templates: Standalone destination star preserves basename; at most one star per stem/extension substitutes whole source components
wildcard_files.publication: Snapshot/preflight complete batch; memory/device prepared mutations, host directory per-file publication with explicit partial IO failure boundary
wildcard_files.limits: 32767 scanned/matched entries, 64 MiB total COPY snapshots and ordinary byte/step/quota/busy/alias checks; no PIP/socket/DAQ wildcard batches or wildcard RENAME

directive_locks.entry: GroupLocks apply_directives defaults false; true atomically requests root LOCKGROUP selection, NOLOCKGROUP none or all configured groups when unspecified
directive_locks.lifetime: Stable root ownership, pause retention, resume without reacquisition and terminal cleanup; startup conflict raises before body mutation and preserves prior owners
directive_locks.boundary: Root-only acquisition; nested program/routine directives do not acquire/release scopes; no bank inference, native lock waiting, motion or servo ownership

inventory: 334 of 334 audited distinct built-in names now have a registered Pythonic form; this does not establish all overloads or native equivalence
historical_notes: Supersedes earlier blanket TRANSLATE, COPY/DELETE star and root directive acquisition exclusions; preserve original per-feature ledger versions and internal strict guards.
